scope: Separate GPU telemetry simulation experiment. Complete selected command rows/outputs, all state samples/series, full8GPU counter snapshots, full5chunk vectors, all native tool calls/results, original research/model reports/operator diff, exact resource manifests/patches/UID cleanup and unsigned Feishu response. No claim of physical defect.
